verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item merging to combine multiple items into one group (rollbar-docs-4/26/52). It also documents Custom Fingerprinting Rules for when the default grouping algorithm separates occurrences you want combined "or vice versa" (rollbar-docs-3/25/51), which covers both directions. Splitting appears to be rule-based reconfiguration rather than a direct unmerge action on an existing item. missing for 10: an explicit split/unmerge action for already-collapsed items, detail on retroactive regrouping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
